class.name: Enemy
class.brief_description: [color=green](User creatable)[/color] The core node used to create enemies in battles in UT-Godot-Engine. Handles all Undertale-style enemy behaviors including turn-based combat, dialogue, animation, and state management.
class.description:
[Enemy] is a core node used to implement enemy characters in battle, working together with [AttackBase], [Bullet], and other components to form an Undertale-style battle system.
[b]Battle System Integration[/b] • Automatic integration with [BattleMain], [AttackManager], [BattleBox], [SoulBattle], etc. • Dialogue system management through [DialogueControl] • Automatic enemy list loading and management in [BattleMain] node
[b]Example (GDScript)[/b] [codeblock] extends Enemy
func _on_get_turn(): # Execute attack pattern box.change_size(Vector2(350, 140), false, 0.3) var attack = attacks.add_attack(preload("res://attacks/test_attack.tscn")) attack.start_attacks()
func on_fight(): play_dialogue(0) # Play first dialogue await finished_dialogue emit_signal("on_fight_end") [/codeblock]
[b]Used Scenes[/b] • res://Battle/Enemies/dust_transition.tscn (death particles) • res://Battle/Enemies/spare.tscn (mercy particles) • res://Battle/Misc/dialogue.tscn (dialogue control)
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: ready
method.description: Enemy initialization function. Should be used instead of the [method Node._ready] method.

method.name: _on_get_turn
method.description: Virtual function called when the enemy's turn begins. Used to execute attack patterns or implement special behaviors.

method.name: _on_end_turn
method.description: Virtual function called when the enemy's turn ends. Used for turn end processing or state cleanup.

method.name: on_fight
method.description: Virtual function called when the player selects FIGHT. Used to implement the enemy's hit reaction or dialogue. If [param miss] is true, it means the attack missed. Must emit the [signal on_fight_end] signal after processing is complete.

method.name: on_act
method.description: Virtual function called when the player selects ACT. [param option] is the index of the selected action. Must emit the [signal on_act_end] signal after processing is complete.

method.name: on_item
method.description: Virtual function called when the player uses an ITEM. [param option] is the index of the used item. Must emit the [signal on_item_end] signal after processing is complete.

method.name: on_mercy
method.description: Virtual function called when the player selects MERCY. Used to implement the enemy's mercy reaction. Must emit the [signal on_mercy_end] signal after processing is complete.

method.name: on_defeat
method.description: Virtual function called when the enemy is defeated. If [param death] is true, it means the enemy died; if false, the enemy was spared. Must emit the [signal on_defeat_end] signal after processing is complete.

method.name: handle_victory
method.description: Virtual function called when the enemy wins. Returns victory message. Default value is "UT_DEFAULT_WIN".

method.name: damage_info
method.description: Virtual function executed when the enemy takes damage. [param amount] is the amount of damage taken. Passing an empty string returns the default output, passing a string outputs that string. Time can be specified like [time=0.5].

method.name: change_act
method.description: Changes the enemy's ACT state. [param act_index] is the index in the [member enemy_acts] array.

method.name: play_dialogue
method.description: Plays dialogue at the specified index. [param index] is the index in the [member dialogues] array. [param duration] is additional delay time, [param skip] is whether skipping is allowed. If [param keep_expression] is true, the expression is maintained after the dialogue.

method.name: play_set_dialogue
method.description: Directly plays the specified [Dialogues] resource. [param duration] is additional delay time, [param skip] is whether skipping is allowed. If [param keep_expression] is true, the expression is maintained after the dialogue.

method.name: modify_stats
method.description: Modifies the enemy's stats. [param value] is a dictionary containing the stats to change. Pass in the format { "hp": number, "max_hp": number, "def": number }.

method.name: get_sprites
method.description: Returns the sprite container node. Used for animation control.

method.name: get_solo
method.description: Returns whether this is a solo battle.

members.member: The enemy's name. Displayed in the battle UI.
Whether to use KR (Karmic Retribution) damage. If true, deals additional damage over time.
Whether to start attacking immediately on the first turn. If true, executes attack patterns immediately without dialogue.
Whether the enemy can dodge attacks. If true, the enemy can dodge when the player attacks.
[DialogueAsset] resource containing the enemy's dialogue list. Used for dialogue sequences during battle.
The current ACT state index of the enemy. Represents an index in the [member enemy_acts] array.
Array of [EnemyAct] resources containing the enemy's ACT states. Referenced when the player selects ACT.
Whether to process states one by one sequentially. Affects the ACT information retrieval method.
Path to the [AudioStreamPlayer] node that plays hit sounds. Does not play when dodging.
Path to the [DustTransition] node that displays death particles.
Path to the [GPUParticles2D] node that displays mercy particles.
Path to the sprite container node. Used for animations and movement effects.
Path to the [DialogueControl] node that controls dialogue.
Array of [AnimatedSprite2D] nodes that control facial expression animations. Used for changing expressions during dialogue.
The enemy's ID. (Read-only)
Reference to the battle system's main node. (Read-only)
Reference to the attack manager node. (Read-only)
Reference to the battle box node. (Read-only)
Reference to the soul node. (Read-only)
Reference to the dialogue control node. (Read-only)
Reference to the camera control node. (Read-only)
Reference to the background node. (Read-only)
Reference to the enemy's battle script. (Read-only)

signal.name: finished_dialogue
signal.description: Emitted when dialogue is completed. Triggered after [method play_dialogue] or [method play_set_dialogue] finishes.

signal.name: changed_act
signal.description: Emitted when the enemy's ACT state changes. Triggered after [method change_act] is called.

signal.name: dodged
signal.description: Signal emitted when the enemy dodges an attack. If [param to_right] is true, the enemy dodged to the right; if false, dodged to the left. Can be used to implement additional effects synchronized with dodge animations.

signal.name: hit
signal.description: Signal emitted when the enemy is hit. [param damage] is the amount of damage taken. Can be used to implement additional effects synchronized with hit animations.

signal.name: on_fight_end
signal.description: Signal that must be emitted when fight action processing is complete. Must be emitted when implementing [method on_fight_used].

signal.name: on_act_end
signal.description: Signal that must be emitted when ACT action processing is complete. Must be emitted when implementing [method on_act_used].

signal.name: on_item_end
signal.description: Signal that must be emitted when item usage processing is complete. Must be emitted when implementing [method on_item_used].

signal.name: on_mercy_end
signal.description: Signal that must be emitted when mercy action processing is complete. Must be emitted when implementing [method on_mercy_used].

signal.name: on_defeat_end
signal.description: Signal that must be emitted when defeat processing (death or mercy) is complete. Must be emitted when implementing [method on_defeat].
